title: IMAX影厅：成旅游地，近半观众跨城来，国庆档能否延续热度？
speaker: Daniel Munwaring

segments.en: Sure. So, you know, to your earlier point, I think you made a good one, which is just this return to the cinemas.
segments.zh: 是的，你之前提到观众回归影院，这点很关键。

segments.en: You know, we've got these theaters in China called GT Auditoriums and they've become destinations for tourism.
segments.zh: 我们在中国的GT影厅已成为旅游打卡地。

segments.en: In fact, almost 50% of the audiences who are attending these GT systems are coming from out of town.
segments.zh: 事实上，近50%的GT影厅观众来自外地。

segments.en: That's something that we've really never seen before where you have huge groups of people flying and taking trains hundreds of miles to go visit this very particular giant GT system that we have.
segments.zh: 我们从未见过如此大规模的人群，乘飞机或火车数百英里，专程来体验我们的巨型GT系统。

segments.en: So, conversation is all around films. I think this momentum is going to continue, you know, typically when you have these big hits over the summer, they bring back that behavior of going back to the cinema.
segments.zh: 话题都围绕电影。我认为这股势头会持续，通常暑期档大片会带动观众重回影院。

segments.en: People start to look ahead at what's coming out. Obviously looking into the future, we've got, you know, the National Holiday, which is coming up during Shiyi, the October 1st, looking ahead of that.
segments.zh: 观众开始期待未来新片。接下来有国庆档‘十一’假期。

segments.en: We have Doom 3, which is scheduled to release hopefully here in China in December, Avengers Doomsday, another massive franchise that has done extremely well in China.
segments.zh: 《毁灭战士3》计划12月在中国上映，《复仇者联盟：末日》也是在中国表现极佳的大IP。
